analysis.session_summary: The overnight NY afternoon-to-Asia window was two-way with no clean catalyst for most major legs. Measured currency strength put CHF (+0.107%) and USD (+0.105%) at the top and NZD (-0.254%) at the bottom; EUR/USD closed -10.4 pips near its low and GBP/USD -14.8 pips near its low. Brent/USD dropped -1.971% while SPX rose +7.6 and VIX fell -5.8, consistent with soft risk-on; Trump Iran-diplomacy headlines briefly sold USD against SEK, ZAR, and MXN before fading. Most major legs carried no confident headline driver.

scenarios.name: EZ PMI disappointment extends EUR/USD lower
scenarios.thesis: EUR/USD closed near the low at 1.14267 (-10.4 pips, 0.04 of range) and EUR strength is -0.001%; French services forecast 48.3 and German services 49.9 leave downside risk. A miss can push EUR/USD through the 29.3-pip range low and drag GBP/USD via UK PMIs.
scenarios.invalidation: EUR/USD holds above 1.14267 and EZ services print at or above forecast.

pair_paths.rationale: Overnight range is 29.3 pips and close is 0.04 of range; weak services PMIs favor extension lower.
UK services forecast 52.0 vs prior 52.8; GBP/USD range 34.0 and close 0.02 of range.
EUR/GBP range is 7.5 pips; both EUR and GBP face soft PMI risk, likely range.
